topic: ChatGPT Search + OpenAI ACP discovery readiness

facts: OAI-SearchBot controls inclusion in ChatGPT search features independently from GPTBot training controls.
Sites opted out of OAI-SearchBot are not shown in ChatGPT search answers, although navigational links may still appear.
Robots changes can take about 24 hours to be reflected.
Product feed onboarding is currently available to approved partners.
The first integration step is a structured product feed.
Use Stable for supported file-upload integrations.
One row is required per purchasable item or variant.
Unknown optional values should be omitted rather than fabricated.

policy: Do not fabricate GTIN, MPN, brand, availability, price or merchant eligibility.
Do not submit a direct OpenAI feed unless partner access is actually approved.
Do not equate ordinary ChatGPT referral traffic with product-feed onboarding.
Keep GPTBot training choice independent from OAI-SearchBot search accessibility.
